name.ja: ぷちりっつ セイバー/宮本武蔵

description.ja: 『Fate/Grand Order』に登場するセイバークラスのサーヴァント、宮本武蔵がぷちりっつシリーズにラインアップ！
description.en: Miyamoto Musashi, the Saber class servant that appears in "Fate/Grand Order", is now available in the Petitrits series!

description.ja: • いろプラを活用したカラフルで組み立てやすいキット。シンプルなパーツ構成で初心者でも手軽に楽しめる組み立てやすさを実現。
description.en: • Colorful and easy-to-assemble kit that utilizes Iropla. The simple parts structure makes it easy to assemble, even for beginners.

description.ja: • ３頭身ながら、キャラクターの特徴あるシルエットラインそのままに、印象を崩すことなくかわいくデフォルメ。
description.en: • Although she has three heads, she maintains the character's distinctive silhouette line and is cutely deformed without losing its impression.

description.ja: • 特徴的な髪型は細かいパーツ分割で再現。
description.en: • The characteristic hairstyle is reproduced by finely divided parts.

description.ja: • 上半身の可動で衣装に合わせた霊基再臨第二段階のポージングが可能！
description.en: • The upper body is movable, allowing you to pose the second stage of Ascension to match your costume!

description.ja: • 柄のディテールまで再現された「水の刀」「炎の刀」にはエフェクトパーツが付属！
description.en: • Effect parts are included for the "Water Sword " and " Flame Sword" that have been reproduced down to the details of their handles!

description.ja: • キャラクターをイメージした専用台座が付属。
description.en: • A special pedestal based on the character is included.
